gold.user: As a developer, I want to retrieve the add-on results for a specific recording so that I can analyze the data processed by the add-ons.
gold.ideal: The API should return a JSON object containing the details of the add-on results for the specified recording, including metadata and processing status.

gold.user: As an administrator, I need to delete specific add-on results for a recording to ensure that outdated or incorrect data is removed from the system.
gold.ideal: The API should confirm the deletion of the specified add-on result and return a success message or status code.

gold.user: As a data analyst, I want to list all add-on results for a specific recording to review the performance and outputs of various add-ons used.
gold.ideal: The API should return an array of add-on results, each containing relevant details such as processing time, status, and any errors encountered.
